headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 9, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the way. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, while the Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels 7-0. The Toronto Blue Jays also secured a hard-fought win over the Philadelphia Phillies, outscoring them 7-5.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners, Minnesota Twins, Cleveland Guardians, Chicago White Sox, and Toronto Blue Jays have also suffered injuries to several players.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 7-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a hard-fought win over the Philadelphia Phillies, outscoring them 7-5. Nathan Lukes led the Blue Jays' offense with a standout performance, hitting 3 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status on the injured list will be reassessed after 10 days.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
